headline: Sanderson Farms: Keith Mitchell fires 64 to seize 54-hole lead at 20-under in Jackson
whyCareReason: Keith Mitchell unleashes an eight-birdie barrage on Moving Day to take a one-stroke lead over Beau Hossler heading into a high-stakes Sunday showdown.

story:
Why this one matters: Moving Day at the Sanderson Farms Championship turned into a putting clinic as Keith Mitchell surged from the chasing pack into the solo 54-hole lead at Country Club of Jackson.

Mitchell posted a sensational 8-under-par 64 on Saturday, highlighted by five birdies on the front nine and an immaculate display off the tee. The 32-year-old sits at 20-under 199, aiming for his second career PGA Tour victory.

Overnight leader Beau Hossler refused to buckle, shooting a bogey-free 68 to stay right on Mitchell's heels at 19-under par. Meanwhile, defending champion Kevin Yu fired a 67 to join former US Open winner Lucas Glover at 15-under. With 500 FedExCup Fall points and two-year tour exemptions on the line, Sunday promises an electric shootout in Mississippi.
stakes: FedExCup Fall points, PGA Tour winner exemptions through 2028, and coveted invitations to the 2027 Masters and PGA Championship.
rivalryAngle: Mitchell's explosive ball-striking collides with Hossler's putting touch in a tense Sunday final pairing.
